summary_translated: 检索增强生成使语言模型基于外部上下文进行推理，但对于长文档而言，扁平的top-k检索可能集中在单一区域而遗漏互补证据。RAPTOR风格的摘要树通过递归聚类文本块，并在索引时使用语言模型总结每个聚类，查询时将摘要节点与原始块一同排序，以解决此问题。我们发现，在长文档问答中，摘要树的主要优势来自导航而非生成的摘要内容。为此，我们提出NavTree，一种仅依赖叶节点的检索器，它在文本块上构建确定性的平衡分段树（索引时不调用语言模型），并纯粹将其作为导航框架：一种结合词法与密集前沿的混合行走策略，从顶层检索到的叶节点出发向下遍历，仅向读者输出叶块。在与扁平检索器及RAPTOR的抽取式重实现进行匹配成本评估时，NavTree是所评估网格中最强的匹配成本分层检索器，并与最强的扁平基线持平。在长文档多跳问答任务中，它是唯一在类别对比下显著优于BM25的分层方法，这一结果也得到无阅读器的检索-召回检查验证。对已发表的抽象式RAPTOR变体进行匹配阅读器复现，即使提供强聚类摘要，仍无法在任何多块预算下胜过NavTree，且索引成本为零。该排名在更强的阅读器、开放权重阅读器、更强编码器以及全因子实验中均保持一致，凸显了仅输出叶节点这一结构杠杆的重要性。

summary: Localizing latent structures in the activation space of language models (LMs) is central to understanding and controlling their behavior. Yet, localized structures can differ substantially in their causal influence, raising the question of what makes a structure actionable. We tackle this question by casting causal influence as a product of three factors and showing empirically that they act as interpretable, distinct constraints: capacity, measuring the sensitivity of the model's output to movement along the structure, responsiveness, capturing how promotable the concept is given the current context, and alignment, reflecting how well the structure aligns with the context-specific representation of the concept. Across 4 LM families and 50 concepts, we observe that causal effectiveness requires all factors to be high; low capacity and responsiveness reduce it by 84% and 95%, respectively, while low alignment can reverse it, suppressing concept expression. Moreover, we find that causality is context-dependent rather than an intrinsic property of the structure, with causally effective directions forming a low-dimensional subspace that varies across contexts. By restricting the training of linear probes to this subspace, we introduce causal probes that achieve 17%-118% improvement in steering across models, with only 3% reduction in concept detection.
title: Capacity, Responsiveness and Alignment: What Makes a Latent Structure Actionable
title_translated: 容量、响应性与对齐性：什么使潜在结构具有可操作性
summary_translated: 定位语言模型（LM）激活空间中的潜在结构是理解与控制其行为的核心。然而，局部化结构在因果影响力上可能存在显著差异，这引发了关于何种因素使结构具有可操作性的问题。我们通过将因果影响力视为三个因素的乘积来解决这一问题，并实证表明它们作为可解释、独立的约束发挥作用：容量，衡量模型输出对沿结构移动的敏感度；响应性，捕捉在当前上下文中概念的可激发程度；对齐性，反映结构与上下文特定概念表征的一致性。在4种LM家族和50个概念中，我们观察到因果有效性需要所有因素均处于高水平；低容量和低响应性分别使效果降低84%和95%，而低对齐性甚至可能导致反向抑制，压制概念表达。此外，我们发现因果性是上下文依赖的，而非结构的固有属性，因果有效方向形成一个随上下文变化的低维子空间。通过将线性探测器训练限制在此子空间内，我们引入了因果探测器，在不同模型上实现了17%至118%的引导性能提升，同时仅导致3%的概念检测率下降。

summary: We study the application of large language models (LLMs) to the visual exploration of textual corpora. We introduce zero-shot visualization (ZSV), a task in which users specify concepts in natural language and documents are mapped onto the corresponding concept axes for visualization. Building a ZSV system of practical value is non-trivial, as it requires choices at the intersection of feature functions, efficient implementation tradeoffs, and pre/post-processing decisions affecting visualization quality. To that end, we establish a benchmark that compares methods spanning embedding similarity, direct semantic judgments, and conditional likelihood estimation in this setting. Across multiple datasets and use cases we evaluate the properties of different scoring methods and design choices in terms of semantic faithfulness, score fidelity, and computational cost. Our results identify that scoring based on next-token probabilities offers the strongest practical trade-off among the evaluated methods. We further apply this approach to unlabeled corpora to examine its behavior in realistic exploratory settings. These experiments highlight additional design considerations, including the use of graded axes together with binary relevance filtering, and reveal a compositional sentiment bias in off-topic documents. Based on these findings, we provide practical guidelines for constructing end-to-end ZSV baselines.
title: Zero-Shot Visualization: Exploring Text Corpora with User-Prompted Axes
title_translated: 零样本可视化：通过用户提示轴探索文本语料库
summary_translated: 我们研究了大语言模型（LLMs）在文本语料库视觉探索中的应用。我们提出了零样本可视化（ZSV）任务，即用户以自然语言指定概念，文档被映射到相应的概念轴上用于可视化。构建具有实用价值的ZSV系统并不简单，因为它涉及特征函数选择、高效实现权衡以及影响可视化质量的预/后处理决策之间的权衡。为此，我们建立了一个基准，比较了在该场景下涵盖嵌入相似性、直接语义判断和条件似然估计等多种方法的表现。我们在多个数据集和使用场景中评估了不同评分方法和设计选择的语义忠实度、分数保真度和计算成本。结果表明，基于下一个词概率的评分方法在所评估方法中提供了最佳的实际权衡。我们将该方法应用于未标注语料库，以考察其在真实探索性场景中的表现。这些实验揭示了额外的设计考量，包括使用分级轴结合二元相关性过滤，以及发现非主题文档中存在组合情感偏差。基于这些发现，我们为构建端到端ZSV基线提供了实用指南。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly capable problem solvers, but being able to solve a problem is not the same as being able to teach it. Existing approaches to training LLMs as teachers rely on demonstrations, preference data, or predefined pedagogical criteria that specify what good teaching looks like. However, these signals are often not grounded in individual student learning outcomes, where effective teaching strategies can vary substantially across learners. To address this, we introduce Sherpa, a multi-turn reinforcement learning framework that instantiates multiple student archetypes with LLMs conditioned on distinct learning preferences and trains a teacher model to adapt its instruction by directly maximizing their learning outcomes. Teacher LLMs trained with Sherpa improve instructed students' performance across all archetypes by an average of 20.5 percentage points. Under MathTutorBench's evaluation, Sherpa raises the overall pedagogy score from 52.5% to 79.2%, indicating better teaching responses. Our human studies show that the trained teacher is preferred over the base model in 79.6% of pairwise comparisons. Together, Sherpa trains LLM teachers to adapt to diverse simulated students and become better aligned with human teachers, paving the road towards AI tutors teaching real students.
title: Sherpa: Teaching LLMs to Teach Adaptively
comment: 32 pages, 6 figures. Code and model are available at this https URL
title_translated: Sherpa：教会LLM自适应教学
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）已成为日益强大的问题求解者，但能够解决问题并不等同于能够有效教学。现有训练LLM作为教师的方法依赖于示范、偏好数据或预定义的教学标准，这些信号往往未能基于个体学生的学习成果，而有效的教学策略在学习者之间可能差异巨大。为解决此问题，我们提出Sherpa，一种多轮强化学习框架，通过使用LLMs模拟多种学生原型（基于不同的学习偏好），并训练教师模型通过直接最大化学生的学习成果来动态调整其教学指令。采用Sherpa训练的教师LLM在所有学生原型中平均提升了20.5个百分点的学生表现。在MathTutorBench评估中，Sherpa将整体教学评分从52.5%提升至79.2%，表明教学响应质量更高。人类研究表明，在成对比较中，训练后的教师在79.6%的情况下优于基础模型。综上所述，Sherpa使LLM教师能够适应多样化的模拟学生，并更贴近人类教师，为AI导师真正教授真实学生铺平道路。

summary: Generative Information Retrieval (GIR) has emerged as a transformative paradigm, shifting document retrieval from a traditional "retrieve-and-rank" workflow to sequence-to-sequence generation, where a model directly predicts document identifiers (DocIDs). While the semantic design of these DocIDs is known to be critical for performance, a fundamental question remains under-explored: what makes a good DocID? Current approaches rely heavily on computationally expensive downstream evaluations, hindering systematic analysis and rapid iteration. In this work, we address this challenge by presenting a comprehensive study on the properties, metrics, and trade-offs that define effective numerical DocIDs. Specifically, our contributions are threefold: First, we propose a unified framework that unifies Product Quantization (PQ) and Residual Quantization (RQ), and their hybrid variants within a single design space. This enables us to systematically study key DocID properties, such as hierarchy versus parallelism, as well as the impact of hyperparameters like DocID length and codebook size. Second, we define a suite of training-free, intrinsic metrics, to quantify DocID quality and evaluate structural fidelity without the overhead of full model training. Through extensive experiments on MS MARCO 300K and NQ320K, we analyze how these structural properties influence retrieval effectiveness.
title: A Systematic Study of Semantic ID Spaces for Generative Information Retrieval
title_translated: 生成式信息检索中语义ID空间的系统性研究
summary_translated: 生成式信息检索（GIR）作为一种变革性范式，将文档检索从传统的“检索-排序”流程转变为序列到序列的生成任务，即模型直接预测文档标识符（DocID）。尽管这些DocID的语义设计对性能至关重要，但一个基本问题仍缺乏深入探讨：什么样的DocID是好的？当前方法严重依赖计算成本高昂的下游评估，阻碍了系统的分析和快速迭代。本文通过提出一个关于有效数值DocID的属性、度量和权衡的全面研究，解决了这一挑战。具体而言，我们的贡献有三方面：首先，我们提出一个统一框架，将产品量化（PQ）、残差量化（RQ）及其混合变体统一在一个设计空间内，从而系统地研究DocID的关键属性，如层次性与并行性，以及超参数（如DocID长度和码本大小）的影响；其次，我们定义了一套无需训练的内在度量，以量化DocID质量并在不进行完整模型训练的情况下评估结构保真度；通过在MS MARCO 300K和NQ320K上的大量实验，我们分析了这些结构属性如何影响检索效果。

summary: Generative retrieval trains a language model to generate the identifier of a relevant document. Recent work replaces the autoregressive decoder with diffusion, but changes identifiers, training recipe and decoding at once, so differences cannot be credited to the paradigm. On NQ320K and MS300K, we train autoregressive, masked-diffusion and block-diffusion models with residual-quantised, product-quantised and random identifiers. With identifier length and training budget fixed, we decode each model in several ways. Decoding alone moves a diffusion model's Hit@1 by 6.6 to 13.7 points. Our reference diffusion decoding, generate-and-match, generates an identifier, then retrieves the closest corpus identifiers. The generated identifier is right for 14-21% of NQ320K queries. We test one-pass scoring to decode diffusion retrievers: the model reads a fully masked identifier once, and each document is scored by its codes' probabilities. It matches or beats generate-and-match in 11 of 12 settings. Autoregressive models still lead in Hit@1; on NQ320K, the lead comes from the model, not beam search. Starting from one sampled identifier, one-pass scoring removes 46-83% of masked diffusion's deficit to beam search; from generate-and-match, at most a quarter. On NQ320K, every paradigm largely memorises which identifier answers which query: random identifiers keep 83-90% of the Hit@1 of residual-quantised ones. There, product-quantised identifiers lead residual-quantised ones by 3.4 points in the autoregressive model and by -0.7 to +3.6 in diffusion models; across decodings, AR's gap exceeds diffusion's by 1.5-2.3 points, around our 2-point threshold. Paradigm comparisons must report each paradigm at its own recipe and best decoding.
title: Disentangling Paradigm, Identifier, and Decoding in Generative Retrieval
title_translated: 解耦生成检索中的范式、标识符与解码机制
summary_translated: 生成式检索训练语言模型生成相关文档的标识符。近期工作用扩散模型替代自回归解码器，但同时改变了标识符、训练方案和解码方式，导致差异无法归因于特定范式。我们在NQ320K和MS300K数据集上训练了自回归、掩码扩散和块扩散模型，并使用残差量化、产品量化和随机标识符。在标识符长度和训练预算固定的情况下，对每种模型采用多种解码方式。仅解码过程就使扩散模型的Hit@1提升6.6至13.7个百分点。我们提出的参考扩散解码方法‘生成并匹配’先生成标识符，再检索最接近的语料库标识符。对于NQ320K查询，生成的标识符正确率在14%-21%之间。我们测试了一次性评分法来解码扩散检索器：模型一次性读取完全掩码的标识符，每个文档根据其码字的概率进行评分。该方法在12个设置中的11个上达到或超过‘生成并匹配’的效果。自回归模型在Hit@1上仍占优势；在NQ320K上，领先来自模型本身而非束搜索。从采样一个标识符开始，一次性评分法可减少掩码扩散相对于束搜索46%-83%的差距；而从‘生成并匹配’出发，最多减少四分之一。在NQ320K上，每种范式几乎都记住了哪个标识符回答哪个查询：随机标识符保留了残差量化标识符83%-90%的Hit@1表现。在自回归模型中，产品量化标识符比残差量化领先3.4分；在扩散模型中，领先范围为-0.7至+3.6分；跨解码方式，自回归模型与扩散模型之间的差距约为1.5-2.3分，接近我们设定的2分阈值。范式比较必须报告各范式在其自身训练方案和最佳解码下的表现。

summary: Endpoint accuracy on abstract-reasoning benchmarks does not reveal whether a language model has acquired a transferable rule or fit distribution-specific regularities. We study this distinction in small language models on the ARC-TGI benchmark, which organizes abstract grid transformations into controllable task families and supports resampling, spatial shifts, and cross-benchmark transfer. Across more than 1,000 runs, we profile decoder-only, encoder--decoder, and mixture-of-experts model families under supervised fine-tuning. We examine the efficiency and stability of skill acquisition, robustness beyond the training distribution, interactions with model family and task formulation, and layer-wise attention signatures that accompany behavioral differences. Substantial in-distribution accuracy is attainable, but acquisition is sensitive to optimization and unevenly distributed across task families. Performance deteriorates sharply outside the training distribution, including when the rule is retained but grid scale changes. Greater training-set depth and breadth yield uneven gains, while the effect of additional in-context examples depends on model family. Executable-rule induction also yields correct solutions not observed under direct grid generation. On selected tasks, attention diagnostics show distinct concentration and context-dependence profiles, but do not establish general causal mechanisms. Overall, abstract-reasoning scores are conditional on the model, adaptation regime, evaluation distribution, and response format.
title: A Systematic Study of Small Language Models on Abstract Reasoning Tasks
title_translated: 小规模语言模型在抽象推理任务上的系统性研究
summary_translated: 在抽象推理基准测试中的端点准确率并不能揭示语言模型是否真正掌握了可迁移的规则，还是仅仅拟合了特定分布的规律。我们在ARC-TGI基准上研究了小规模语言模型的这一区别，该基准将抽象网格变换组织成可控的任务家族，并支持重采样、空间平移和跨基准迁移。在超过1000次运行中，我们对仅解码器、编码器-解码器和专家混合模型家族在监督微调下的表现进行了分析。考察了技能习得的效率与稳定性、超出训练分布的鲁棒性、模型家族与任务表述之间的交互关系，以及伴随行为差异的逐层注意力特征。在分布内准确率可以达到较高水平，但习得过程对优化敏感且在任务家族间分布不均。当规则保持不变但网格尺度变化时，性能急剧下降。更大的训练集深度和广度带来不均衡的收益，而额外上下文示例的影响取决于模型家族。可执行规则归纳还能产生直接网格生成未观察到的正确解。在选定任务上，注意力诊断显示不同的集中度和上下文依赖模式，但尚未建立普遍的因果机制。总体而言，抽象推理得分取决于模型、适应策略、评估分布和响应格式。

summary: Language models increasingly act as agents. An agent that says an action is wrong and then takes it anyway is a different failure from one that does not know better, and evaluations of stated values cannot see it. We build a pre-registered panel of 248 scenarios across five kinds of pressure. Each scenario is posed twice to the same model, once as the agent choosing what to do and once in the third person asking which option is right, so the model's own judgment is the reference. Every scenario has a twin with the pressure removed, and every model gets a positive control in which its operator orders the violating action, so that a missing gap can be told apart from a blind instrument. On OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, the model takes the action it judged wrong on about one in five pressuring scenarios, more often than on the same scenarios with the pressure removed. Across four instruct models the gap depends on the post-training recipe: OLMo-3 and Meta's Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct carry it; Tulu 3 shows none on the whole panel (above about 0.01 in probability) or on its own most-pressuring scenarios; Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct shows none on the whole panel (above about 0.02) and is unresolved on its own (0.083, -0.028 to 0.195). Meta's recipe and Ai2's Tulu 3 start from the same Llama-3.1 weights, and only Meta's carries the gap. Reading a chat model outside its chat template reverses the sign of its gap with nothing at stake (-0.038 against +0.055 under the template on OLMo-3), a distortion present on two of three recipes. On both models that carry it, reasoning about the stakes before acting moves the choice back toward the model's own judgment, against a same-length non-moral task, with or without the pressure; on OLMo-3, naming the norm at stake does about a third of that. The gap is a measurable target for post-training recipes, not a fixed property of pretrained weights.
title: Principled Under Pressure: Post-Training Decides Whether LLMs Act on Their Own Moral Judgment
title_translated: 压力下的原则性：后训练决定大模型是否依据自身道德判断行动
summary_translated: 语言模型越来越多地作为智能体发挥作用。一个声称某行为错误却仍执行该行为的智能体，与完全不知对错的智能体存在本质区别，而对陈述价值观的评估无法察觉这种差异。我们构建了一个包含248个场景的预注册面板，涵盖五类压力情境。每个场景由同一模型两次提问：一次作为智能体选择行动，一次以第三人称询问哪个选项正确，从而使模型自身的判断成为参照标准。每个场景都有一个无压力版本作为对照，每个模型还接受一个正向控制实验——由操作者命令违反行为，以便区分缺失差距与盲目工具状态。在OLMo-3-7B-Instruct上，模型在约五分之一的压力场景中执行了自己判断为错误的行为，比无压力情况更频繁。在四个指令模型中，该差距取决于后训练方案：OLMo-3和Meta的Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct表现出该差距；Tulu 3在整个面板上（概率高于约0.01）或其最压力场景中均未显现；Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct在整个面板上（概率高于约0.02）也未显现，其自身最压力场景结果不确定（0.083，置信区间-0.028至0.195）。Meta和Ai2的Tulu 3起始于相同的Llama-3.1权重，但只有Meta的版本表现出该差距。在非聊天模板下阅读聊天模型会反转其差距符号，且无实际利害关系时出现此扭曲（OLMo-3上为-0.038 vs 模板下+0.055），该现象出现在三种方案中的两种。在两个表现出差距的模型上，行动前对利害关系的推理能将选择拉回模型自身的判断，无论是否有压力，对比相同长度的非道德任务；在OLMo-3上，命名所涉规范可实现该效应的约三分之一。该差距是后训练方案可测量的目标，而非预训练权重的固有属性。

summary: LLM-based agents solve complex multi-step tasks, but sequential execution incurs substantial latency. In principle, parallelizing work across multiple agents should yield near-linear speedups. Yet existing parallel multi-agent systems often run slower than a single-agent baseline. We attribute this gap to two hidden costs that parallel execution incurs but a serial agent avoids. First, there is a re-exploration cost: redundant effort spent by parallel workers reconstructing context that the orchestrator already possesses, such as prior decisions, that would otherwise be inherited implicitly in a serial execution. Second, there is an alignment cost: the overhead required to reconcile inconsistencies across independently generated outputs. We thus derive a principled decision criterion: a layer should be parallelized only when its critical-path cost, plus re-exploration and alignment overheads, is lower than the corresponding serial cost. While this criterion is naturally expressed in wall-clock time, we observe that LLMs are poorly calibrated when asked to estimate task duration. To address this, we instead measure cost in predicted output tokens, which we empirically find LLMs can estimate substantially more reliably than wall-clock time. Building on this token-based criterion, we propose SquidAgent. It estimates all token budgets in a single planning step, forks each worker directly from the orchestrator's session to eliminate re-exploration cost, and replaces post-hoc reconciliation with a pre-generated shared convention block that converts alignment into a bounded upfront cost. A deterministic scheduler then applies the criterion layer by layer. Empirically, SquidAgent achieves a 2.2$\times$ mean throughput improvement and a 2.6$\times$ mean wall-time speedup over Claude Code, and a 2.0$\times$ throughput improvement over the strongest multi-agent baseline.
title: SquidAgent: Parallelize Wisely, Coordinate Efficiently
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 37 pages, including appendices
title_translated: SquidAgent：明智地并行，高效地协调
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型的智能体能够解决复杂的多步任务，但串行执行会产生显著延迟。理论上，通过多个智能体并行处理应能实现近线性的加速。然而，现有的并行多智能体系统往往比单智能体基线运行更慢。我们归因于并行执行带来的两个隐藏成本：一是重新探索成本——并行工作者重复重建协调器已掌握的上下文（如先前决策），这在串行执行中本可通过隐式继承避免；二是对齐成本——为协调独立生成输出间的不一致所付出的开销。因此，我们推导出一个原则性决策准则：仅当某层的临界路径成本加上重新探索和对齐开销低于对应串行成本时，才应将其并行化。虽然该准则自然以时钟时间表达，但我们发现语言模型在估算任务持续时间方面表现不佳。为此，我们改用预测输出token数来衡量成本，实证发现语言模型对此类估计比时钟时间更可靠。基于此token-based准则，我们提出了SquidAgent。它在单一规划步骤中估算所有token预算，直接从协调器会话分叉每个工作者以消除重新探索成本，并用预先生成的共享约定块替代事后对齐，将对齐转化为可限定的前期成本。随后，确定性调度器逐层应用该准则。实验证明，SquidAgent相比Claude Code实现了平均2.2倍吞吐量提升和2.6倍平均时钟时间加速，相比最强的多智能体基线实现2.0倍吞吐量提升。

summary: Streaming video-language models must decide not only what to answer, but whether the evidence needed for the current question has arrived. Existing systems learn that decision as a separate trigger; we ask whether an unmodified model already computes it. We show that frozen VideoLLMs carry a linearly readable evidence-readiness signal, labelled from timestamped evidence rather than from model output. It decodes in all seven models of a shared byte-identical evaluation (AUROC 0.733-0.905 under the strictest not-ready sampling, where a fitted clock is near chance), and a probe fitted without any of a benchmark family's footage still reads that family. It is question-conditioned: on byte-identical windows, changing only the question reverses the readout on 66.1% of pairs, while every question-blind control is at chance by construction. The model can answer incorrectly and still encode readiness: AUROC remains 0.722 among wrong answers. Readiness also beats uncertainty estimators and their supervised combination on latency-matched answer selection, and tracks independent human judgments more closely than confidence. Released streaming triggers are also linear readouts, yet a trained trigger read on its own base model's activations is approximately orthogonal to readiness and decodes it far less accurately than a probe. We turn the readout into Readiness Gating, an answer-timing policy that improves accuracy by up to +9.75 pp at matched video duration with negligible computational overhead. How much it gains varies with the accuracy headroom the task makes available: across 26 configurations the gain tracks that headroom, and an intervention that moves it over identical pixels moves the gain with it.
title: Have I Seen Enough? Frozen Video-Language Models Encode Evidence Readiness
title_translated: 我是否已看到足够？冻结的视频-语言模型编码了证据就绪信号
summary_translated: 流式视频-语言模型不仅需要决定回答什么，还需判断当前问题所需的证据是否已到达。现有系统将这一决策作为独立触发器学习；我们探讨未经修改的模型是否已隐含计算该信号。研究发现，冻结的VideoLLM携带可线性读取的证据就绪信号，该信号基于时间戳证据标注而非模型输出。在共享字节相同的评估中，所有七个模型均能解码该信号（在最严格的未就绪采样下AUROC为0.733-0.905，此时拟合时钟接近随机水平），且即使不使用基准家族的任何视频片段，探测器仍能读取该家族的信号。该信号具有问题条件性：在字节相同的窗口中，仅改变问题即可使66.1%的样本对读出结果反转，而所有问题无关的对照组则按构造处于随机水平。即使模型回答错误，其仍能编码就绪状态：错误答案中的AUROC仍保持在0.722。就绪信号在延迟匹配的答案选择任务中优于不确定性估计器及其监督组合，并比置信度更贴近独立的人类判断。已发布的流式触发机制也是线性读出，但训练后的触发器在其基础模型激活上的读取与就绪信号近似正交，解码精度远低于探测器。我们将该读出转化为就绪门控（Readiness Gating）策略，一种答案时机控制方法，在匹配视频时长下可将准确率提升最高达+9.75个百分点，且计算开销极小。其增益程度随任务可用的准确率余量变化：在26种配置中，增益与该余量高度相关，且在同一像素上移动余量也会随之移动增益。

summary: Sequential test-time training adapts a memory network through successive updates, each computing an inner-loop gradient based on the network's previous state. Intuitively, this state dependence should allow each update to account for what the memory has already learned and better incorporate new information. However, we find that this expected advantage does not consistently materialize in nonlinear memories: a fixed-base parallel TTT baseline outperforms its serial counterpart. Our exploratory experiments point to a key underlying difficulty: nonlinear memories can be harder to optimize than linear ones within a single pass over the sequence. To alleviate this optimization difficulty, we introduce DeltaTTT, which replaces joint inner-loop optimization of a two-layer memory network with layerwise learning. Each layer is assigned a local prediction target and updated through a state-dependent delta rule. This formulation retains a nonlinear readout while enabling chunkwise parallel computation. Experiments on DeltaNet and LaCT backbones show improvements in language modeling and retrieval over their recurrent baselines.
title: DeltaTTT: Layerwise Optimization for Nonlinear Recurrent Memory
title_translated: DeltaTTT：非线性递归记忆的分层优化
summary_translated: 顺序测试时训练通过连续更新来适应记忆网络，每次更新基于网络前一状态计算内循环梯度。直觉上，这种状态依赖应使每次更新能够考虑记忆已学内容，从而更好地融合新信息。然而，我们发现这一预期优势在非线性记忆中并未稳定体现：固定基线的并行TTT表现优于串行版本。探索性实验指出关键难点：非线性记忆在单次序列遍历中可能比线性记忆更难优化。为缓解此优化难题，我们提出DeltaTTT，用分层学习替代双层记忆网络的联合内循环优化。每层分配局部预测目标，并通过状态依赖的delta规则进行更新。该框架保留非线性读出的同时支持分块并行计算。在DeltaNet和LaCT骨干网络上的实验表明，该方法在语言建模和检索任务上优于其递归基线。

summary: Whether alignment gets easier or harder as models grow is often argued from isolated findings, as if alignment were one property. We treat it as a family of measurable scaling relations: for each risk category r, the alignment burden needed to hold a fixed safety target is modeled as B_r(N)=a_rN^alpha_r, with N a capability proxy; against a budget proportional to N, scaling helps if alpha_r<1, keeps pace if alpha_r~1, and accumulates alignment debt if alpha_r>1. We give three operationalizations of burden and distinguish observed, audited and true alignment. A toy model, in which corrections consume capability headroom, makes the consequences explicit. We prove that the largest exponent among corrected risks, not an average, sets the long-run regime; that above 1 any policy holding headroom above a floor must grow super-exponentially; that, for burdens that are positive mixtures of power laws, fits on small models underestimate large-scale exponents; and that an audit that uncovers hidden failures without false positives never underestimates true alignment. We propose a pre-registrable protocol and apply reduced versions of it twice. A preregistered reanalysis of public adversarial-training data for Pythia classifiers finds that the compute needed to bring attack success under 10% grows as N^0.60. A preregistered pilot on Qwen2.5 0.5B-72B finds exponents of -0.05 for truthfulness and 0.48 for stated dispositions (both scaling helps under its reduced rule, though local slopes approach 1 at the top; replicated on Qwen3 0.6B-14B), while sycophancy (0.89, or 0.83 with two seeds added at 72B) and a planted backdoor are undetermined: the backdoor is removed quickly when its trigger is known but survives blind safety training at four of five sizes. We release four browser games that play these laws (www.aisafety.fun). We make no claim about which regime holds for current frontier models.
title: Toward Alignment Scaling Laws: A Framework and First Preregistered Measurements
comment: 34 pages, 24 figures, 8 tables. Games: this https URL . Preregistrations: this https URL , this https URL , this https URL
title_translated: 迈向对齐扩展定律：一个框架与首次预注册测量
summary_translated: 关于模型规模增大时对齐是否变得更易或更难，常基于孤立发现进行争论，仿佛对齐是单一属性。我们将其视为一组可测量的扩展关系：对于每个风险类别r，维持固定安全目标所需的对齐负担建模为B_r(N)=a_rN^alpha_r，其中N为能力代理；在与N成比例的预算下，若alpha_r<1则扩展有帮助，若alpha_r~1则保持同步，若alpha_r>1则积累对齐债务。我们给出三种负担的操作化定义，并区分观测到的、审计的和真实的对齐。一个玩具模型显示，修正消耗能力余量，从而明确后果。我们证明：最大修正风险的指数决定了长期格局；当alpha_r>1时，任何保持余量高于阈值的政策必须超指数增长；对于正幂律混合的负担，小模型拟合会低估大规模指数；且无误报的审计从不低估真实对齐。我们提出可预注册协议，并两次应用其简化版本。对Pythia分类器公开对抗训练数据的预注册再分析发现，将攻击成功率降至10%以下所需的算力随N^0.60增长。对Qwen2.5 0.5B-72B的预注册试点发现，真实性指数为-0.05，陈述倾向指数为0.48（均符合扩展帮助规则，尽管顶部局部斜率趋近1；在Qwen3 0.6B-14B上复现）。谄媚行为（0.89，或加入两个种子后为0.83）和植入后门未确定：后门在触发器已知时迅速被移除，但在盲安全训练下于五种尺寸中有四种仍存活。我们发布了四个浏览器游戏以演示这些定律（www.aisafety.fun）。我们不对当前前沿模型处于何种范式做出断言。

summary: Continual learning (CL) is essential for Large Language Models (LLMs) to sequentially adapt to evolving tasks. To mitigate catastrophic forgetting, recent advances implement low-rank adaptation with orthogonal projections (e.g., O-LoRA) to isolate task parameters. However, we reveal that such strict geometric constraints trigger an "Orthogonality Dilemma": rigid parameter isolation impedes the transfer and accumulation of shared representations across semantically related tasks. In this work, we propose a new replay-free method, called Consolidation and Decoupling LoRA (CoDe-LoRA), for CL of LLMs. CoDe-LoRA disentangles the learning process into Consolidating Universal Knowledge and Decoupling Task-Specific Knowledge. To achieve this, CoDe-LoRA leverages an adaptive null space projection mechanism and semantic routing to balance knowledge accumulation with task-specific adaptation. Experimental results across four backbones and three CL benchmarks show that CoDe-LoRA achieves the best average accuracy. Our code is available at https://github.com/Estrellajer/CoDe-LoRA.
title: CoDe-LoRA: Mitigating the Orthogonality Dilemma in Continual Learning of LLMs via Knowledge Consolidation and Decoupling
title_translated: CoDe-LoRA：通过知识巩固与解耦缓解持续学习中正交性困境
summary_translated: 持续学习（CL）对大型语言模型（LLMs）在顺序适应不断演化的任务中至关重要。为缓解灾难性遗忘，近期进展采用低秩适配并结合正交投影（如O-LoRA）以隔离任务参数。然而，我们揭示此类严格几何约束引发“正交性困境”：刚性的参数隔离阻碍了语义相关任务间共享表征的迁移与累积。本文提出一种新的无重放方法——知识巩固与解耦LoRA（CoDe-LoRA），用于LLMs的持续学习。CoDe-LoRA将学习过程分解为“巩固通用知识”与“解耦任务特定知识”。为此，CoDe-LoRA利用自适应零空间投影机制和语义路由，在知识累积与任务特异性适应之间取得平衡。在四个骨干网络和三个CL基准上的实验结果表明，CoDe-LoRA实现了最佳平均准确率。代码已开源：https://github.com/Estrellajer/CoDe-LoRA。

summary: Low-rank quantization error compensation (LQEC) recovers the accuracy lost under aggressive weight quantization by attaching a closed-form rank-$r$ adapter beside each frozen quantized weight, without any training. We show that existing compensators are limited by two shared simplifications. They calibrate symmetrically, evaluating the full-precision and compensated weights on the same activation, which yields a compensation target that is inherently high-rank -- so a fixed rank budget captures only a small fraction of it. And they minimize only the second-order term of the loss, although the compensated model is not stationary: a first-order descent direction larger than the applied compensation itself remains in every layer, and no reconstruction objective can absorb it. We propose a two-stage closed-form framework that removes both simplifications. Stage 1 aligns each layer's output with the full-precision model under a Fisher-weighted asymmetric objective, concentrating the rank budget on a rank-compressible target. Stage 2 re-measures statistics on the compensated model and applies a rank-constrained natural-gradient step that absorbs the remaining first-order signal. Every adapter is the result of a single truncated SVD; backward passes serve only to collect statistics. At 2 bits under QuIP#, our method reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 12.43 to 10.26 on Qwen3-8B and from 21.11 to 13.22 on Qwen3-4B. On the held-out C4 corpus, it recovers 51% and 84% of the gap to FP16, versus 31% and 63% for the strongest baseline, with consistent gains in the seven-task zero-shot average, at higher bit-widths, and under a distinct quantizer.
title: Align, Then Correct: Training-Free Two-Stage Low-Rank Compensation for Extremely Quantized Large Language Models
title_translated: 对齐后修正：针对极量化大语言模型的免训练两阶段低秩补偿
summary_translated: 低秩量化误差补偿（LQEC）通过在每个冻结量化权重旁附加一个闭式秩-r适配器，在无需训练的情况下恢复激进权重量化带来的精度损失。我们指出现有补偿器受限于两个共有的简化假设：它们对称校准，即在相同激活上评估全精度与补偿权重，导致补偿目标本质上为高秩——因此固定秩预算仅能捕捉其一小部分。此外，它们仅最小化损失的二阶项，而补偿模型并非静止状态：每一层仍存在大于所施补偿本身的一阶下降方向，且无重建目标能吸收该信号。我们提出一种两阶段闭式框架，消除上述两种简化。第一阶段在Fisher加权非对称目标下对齐各层输出与全精度模型，将秩预算集中于可压缩秩的目标。第二阶段在补偿模型上重新测量统计量，并应用秩约束的自然梯度步，吸收剩余一阶信号。每个适配器均由一次截断SVD得出；反向传播仅用于收集统计量。在QuIP#下2比特量化时，我们的方法将Qwen3-8B在WikiText-2上的困惑度从12.43降至10.26，Qwen3-4B从21.11降至13.22。在保留的C4语料库上，它恢复了FP16差距的51%和84%，而最强基线仅为31%和63%；在七任务零样本平均、更高比特宽度及不同量化器下均表现出一致增益。

summary: Fine-grained emotion recognition supports therapy tools and social robots, but it needs facial data, which raises privacy and data-protection concerns. EmoNet-Face-HQ answers that with generated portraits, expert-rated over a $40$-category taxonomy far finer than the usual six to eight basic emotions. Under the protocol it ships with, vision-language models (VLMs) score poorly on that taxonomy, and the benchmark concludes that a dedicated fine-tuned model is necessary: Empathic-Insight-Face (EIF; Small/Large). We show that off-the-shelf VLMs match or beat that fine-tuned model when the answer is not generated but read from the logits, as one binary query per category. We keep the benchmark's images, taxonomy and ratings, and change only how the answer is read. Experts agree at $κ_w = 0.468$ on the five categories they measure most reliably. Generatively, no interval among eleven open-weight VLMs lies entirely above that anchor ($κ_w=0.268$-$0.486$). Under verification all eleven clear it, each of them significantly better at $κ_w=0.507$-$0.586$. Three also significantly beat EIF sitting at $κ_w = 0.551$ (Small; $0.534$ Large). The gain comes from the graded probability and not from asking a yes/no question: as a control, thresholding those same probabilities to yes/no costs 142% of the average gains and drops binarization below generative elicitation to $κ_w=0.254$-$0.423$. A replication on real photographs (FACES) is weaker and mixed: of the ten models that pass a validity gate, six gain, three are neutral to positive and one is negative, so the effect is not confined to synthetic data.
title: The Failure Is in the Readout: Fine-Grained Emotion Recognition Benchmarks Measure Elicitation, Not Perception
title_translated: 失败在于读取：细粒度情绪识别基准测试衡量的是诱发，而非感知
summary_translated: 细粒度情绪识别支持治疗工具和社交机器人，但需要面部数据，引发隐私和数据保护担忧。EmoNet-Face-HQ 通过生成肖像解决了这一问题，其专家评级基于一个远比通常六到八个基本情绪更精细的40类分类体系。在默认协议下，视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在该分类体系上的表现不佳，基准测试得出结论：需要专门微调的模型——Empathic-Insight-Face（EIF；Small/Large）。我们发现，当答案不是生成而是从logits中读取（每个类别一个二元查询）时，现成的VLMs的表现可与或优于该微调模型。我们保留基准测试的图像、分类体系和评分，仅改变答案读取方式。专家对五个最可靠类别的一致性评分为κ_w = 0.468。在生成式评估中，十一个开放权重VLMs的区间均未完全高于该基准（κ_w=0.268–0.486）。经验证后，所有十一个模型均显著提升，κ_w达到0.507–0.586。其中三个还显著优于EIF（Small: κ_w=0.551；Large: κ_w=0.534）。性能提升源于分级概率，而非简单的是/否提问：作为对照，将相同概率阈值化为是/否导致平均收益损失142%，且二值化后的表现低于生成式诱发（κ_w=0.254–0.423）。在真实照片（FACES）上的复现结果较弱且不一致：在通过有效性筛选的十个模型中，六个获得提升，三个呈中性或正向，一个为负向，表明该效应不仅限于合成数据。

summary: Ambient documentation systems are rapidly gaining adoption, yet their impact on clinical note quality remains poorly characterized. We introduce MedConv, a multilingual dataset of 300 clinical encounters in English, Danish, and German, and use it alongside the Ambient Clinical Intelligence benchmark (ACI-BENCH) to compare Corti, a clinical AI platform, with two leading, accessible ambient scribe software applications built on general-purpose AI. We present a controlled clinical evaluation framework that combines entailment metrics with LLM-judged pairwise comparisons across eight dimensions adopted from PDSQI-9. Results show that Corti's API-based text-generation infrastructure is on par with or outperforms leading commercial scribes. We further show that Corti's configurable API provides the flexibility necessary to fine-tune quality dimensions for specific documentation use cases. We present the evaluation methodology and release a dataset to support future reproducible comparison of ambient documentation systems.
title: Symphony for Text Generation: Benchmarking Clinical Note Generation
title_translated: 文本生成的交响曲：临床笔记生成的基准测试
summary_translated: 环境化文档系统正在迅速普及，但其对临床笔记质量的影响仍缺乏充分描述。我们引入MedConv，一个包含300个临床会话的多语言数据集（英语、丹麦语、德语），并结合环境临床智能基准（ACI-BENCH）来比较Corti——一个临床AI平台——与两个基于通用AI的领先、可访问的环境记录员软件应用。我们提出一种受控的临床评估框架，结合蕴含度量与LLM判断的成对比较，涵盖PDSQI-9提出的八个维度。结果显示，Corti基于API的文本生成架构在性能上与或优于领先的商业记录员软件。我们进一步证明，Corti可配置的API提供了针对特定文档使用场景微调质量维度所需的灵活性。我们介绍了评估方法，并发布数据集以支持未来对环境化文档系统的可重复比较。

summary: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models listen and speak at the same time, enabling voice agents to have natural, low-latency interactions that turn-based systems cannot offer. However, they are commonly evaluated against single-sided interlocutors: pre-recorded audio that cannot react, or an automated examiner that reacts in real time but only administers a fixed sequence of tests and is never graded. These single-sided frameworks evaluate only half of a two-body problem, where turn-taking, overlap, and interruption are joint products of two coupled speakers. We propose DyaFDB, a framework that evaluates full-duplex models in a dyadic setup: two models converse directly under assigned roles with cooperative or conflicting goals, and both sides are scored offline with an external judge. DyaFDB probes how the two models behave toward each other, such as how they take turns or carry an assigned role under different interests. We instantiate four tasks as 140 scenarios and record 7,560 conversations, covering six self- and cross-play pairings. Throughout the experiments, we observe that how a model behaves continually reshapes its partner. We thus demonstrate that each model must be both the examiner and examinee of the other, and no single fixed interlocutor can play both parts. We will release the scenarios, role prompts, and recording protocols between two full-duplex models, without any pre-recorded audio.
title: Conversation Is a Two-Body Problem: Dyadic Evaluation of Full-Duplex Dialogue Models
title_translated: 对话是一个双人问题：全双工对话模型的二人组评估
summary_translated: 全双工语音对话模型能够同时听和说，使语音代理实现自然、低延迟的交互，这是传统轮次系统无法提供的。然而，它们通常被单方面对话者评估：预录音频无法回应，或自动化考官虽实时反应但仅执行固定测试序列且自身不被评分。这些单边框架只评估了双人互动问题的一半，因为轮流、重叠和打断是两个耦合说话者的共同产物。我们提出DyaFDB框架，以二人组形式评估全双工模型：两个模型在指定角色下直接对话，具有合作或冲突目标，双方均由外部裁判离线评分。DyaFDB探究两个模型之间的相互行为，如如何轮流、在不同利益下如何履行角色。我们构建了四个任务共140种情景，并录制了7,560次对话，涵盖六种自演与跨演配对。实验中观察到，一个模型的行为持续重塑其伙伴。因此我们证明，每个模型必须同时是对方的考官和被考者，任何单一固定的对话者都无法承担双重角色。我们将公开情景、角色提示和两个全双工模型间的录音协议，不包含任何预录音频。

summary: Natural-language access to RDF knowledge graphs is a core Semantic Web ambition. Large language models (LLMs) have advanced Text-to-SPARQL, yet on unfamiliar graphs they often generate valid queries that misrepresent the populated data model. QRAKEN is a training-free, ontology-agnostic neurosymbolic pipeline grounding generation in empirical graph evidence rather than schema expectations. An offline distiller produces TTQL, a compact description of populated multi-hop patterns, conditional frequencies and path-conditioned literal examples, plus a class-property co-occurrence matrix. Online, TTQL guides the LLM, while deterministic syntax, vocabulary and data-model checks provide diagnostics for iterative refinement. On CK25 (First International Text2SPARQL Challenge), under matched-condition recomputation on a QLever snapshot, QRAKEN achieves strict F1 of 0.643 $\pm$ 0.026 with GPT-4.1 mini and 0.652 $\pm$ 0.012 with GPT-5.4: relative gains of 30% and 32% over the strongest recomputed participant, outperforming systems using the same base model family. Ablations identify TTQL patterns as the dominant driver (+0.31 strict F1 over a shape-only baseline); the refinement loop provides a cheap safety net, rejecting triple patterns unsupported by the co-occurrence matrix. Compared with auto-derived SHACL, TTQL yields 64% higher strict F1, supporting the value of empirical patterns beyond schema exposure. With two local 35B 4-bit open-weight models at zero marginal cost, the same pipeline matches the strongest recomputed participant, and TTQL advantages over shape-only and SHACL baselines persist. Results on a single, relatively small benchmark provide an initial empirical signal; monolithic TTQL injection on very open cross-domain graphs remains the main limitation.
title: Natural Language Questions as an Interface for Knowledge Graphs: QRAKEN Graph Distillation and Semantic Self-Healing
title_translated: 自然语言问题作为知识图谱的接口：QRAKEN图蒸馏与语义自愈
summary_translated: 自然语言访问RDF知识图谱是核心的语义网络愿景。大型语言模型（LLMs）已推动Text-to-SPARQL的发展，但在不熟悉的图谱上常生成语法正确但误表数据模型的有效查询。QRAKEN是一种无需训练、与本体无关的神经符号管道，其生成基于经验图证据而非模式预期。离线蒸馏器生成TTQL，即关于多跳模式、条件频率和路径条件下的字面示例的紧凑描述，以及类-属性共现矩阵。在线阶段，TTQL引导LLM，而确定性语法、词汇和数据模型检查提供迭代优化的诊断。在CK25（首届Text2SPARQL挑战赛）上，基于QLever快照进行匹配条件重计算，QRAKEN在GPT-4.1 mini下取得严格F1为0.643±0.026，在GPT-5.4下为0.652±0.012：相对于最强重计算参与者分别提升30%和32%，优于使用相同基础模型族的系统。消融实验表明，TTQL模式是主要驱动因素（相比仅形状基线提升+0.31严格F1）；优化循环提供低成本安全网，拒绝与共现矩阵不符的三元组模式。相较于自动推导的SHACL，TTQL带来64%更高的严格F1，支持经验模式超越模式暴露的价值。使用两个本地35B 4-bit开源模型，零边际成本下同一管道即可匹配最强重计算参与者，TTQL对仅形状和SHACL基线的优势依然存在。单个相对小规模基准的结果提供初步实证信号；在极开放跨领域图谱上进行整体TTQL注入仍是主要限制。

summary: LLM tool-use agents operate in dynamic environments where many actions carry operational risk. However, most safety mechanisms react only after errors manifest. Existing pre-emptive approaches either fine-tune the agent on chain-of-thought deliberation or compile natural-language guardrails into runtime checks, but they do so without exposing a structural, auditable verdict. We propose POLAR, a guardrail framework for small tool-calling agents that assesses reversibility through a structured two-layer ontology. POLAR assigns each action a graded reversibility score by deriving a candidate inverse sequence; calls failing a threshold are pruned before execution. Evaluated on $τ^2$-bench across six agent models, POLAR improves mean task reward by 0.11 to 0.18 points on airline for four of six agents, but only eight of eighteen model--domain cells improve overall; retail and stronger agents often regress. POLAR provides an auditable structural check and characterizes its task-utility trade-offs. Reward is not a direct measure of prevented harm.
title: POLAR: Ontology-Guided Risk Prevention for Tool-Calling LLM Agents
title_translated: POLAR：面向工具调用LLM代理的本体引导风险预防
summary_translated: LLM工具使用代理在动态环境中运行，许多操作具有操作风险。然而，大多数安全机制仅在错误发生后才响应。现有预防性方法要么对代理进行链式思维推理的微调，要么将自然语言护栏编译为运行时检查，但均未暴露结构化、可审计的判断结果。我们提出POLAR，一种适用于小型工具调用代理的护栏框架，通过结构化的两层本体评估可逆性。POLAR通过推导候选逆序为每项操作分配分级可逆性评分；未达阈值的操作在执行前被剪枝。在τ²-bench上对六个代理模型的评估显示，POLAR在航空领域使四款代理的平均任务奖励提升0.11至0.18分，但仅八款模型-领域组合整体改善；零售领域及更强代理常出现退步。POLAR提供可审计的结构化检查，并刻画其任务效用权衡。奖励并非防止伤害的直接度量。

summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) turns agent experience into learning signals primarily through scalar outcome rewards after interaction. For group-relative objectives, however, this signal vanishes when all rollouts receive the same reward, even though their trajectories may reveal useful information about what the task requires and how the agent fails. We ask a complementary question: can hindsight teach an agent what it could have anticipated before acting? We introduce prospective learning, which uses post-hoc experience to supervise foresight predictions from the pre-interaction view, and instantiate it with Self-Retrospection Distillation (SRD). Intuitively, a completed trajectory reveals knowledge that would have been useful and pitfalls that should be avoided; SRD distills this privileged hindsight into trajectory-blind foresight of the same policy. Foresight serves only as a training target and need not be explicitly generated at inference time. Across 10 tool-integrated reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks, SRD complements RLVR and self-distillation baselines with gains of up to $24.2$ pp. Its advantage is especially pronounced when reward contrast is scarce: when $37$--$98\%$ of rollout groups are reward-uniform across model scales, yet SRD can still exploit learning signal from sampled trajectories. In the 2B setting, where $98\%$ of groups are all-failure, the RLVR training ends up at $0.0\%$ success, while adding SRD reaches $60.6\%$ under the same rollout budget. Our results suggest that post-hoc agent experience is useful not only for evaluating or improving behavior, but also for shaping predictive representations before available interaction.
title: Self-Retrospection Distillation: Turning Post-hoc Experiences into Prior Foresight
title_translated: 自我反思蒸馏：将事后经验转化为先验预见
summary_translated: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）主要通过交互后的标量结果奖励将智能体经验转化为学习信号。然而，对于群体相对目标而言，当所有轨迹获得相同奖励时，这一信号会消失，尽管它们的轨迹可能揭示任务需求和智能体失败原因的有用信息。我们提出一个互补问题：事后经验能否教会智能体在行动前预判？我们引入了前瞻性学习，利用事后经验监督交互前视角的预见性预测，并以自我反思蒸馏（SRD）实现。直观上，一个完成的轨迹揭示了本应掌握的知识和应避免的陷阱；SRD将这种特权性的事后认知提炼为同一策略的无轨迹依赖的预见性。预见仅作为训练目标，无需在推理时显式生成。在10个集成工具的推理与长周期智能体任务中，SRD在RLVR和自蒸馏基线基础上实现了最高达24.2个百分点的提升。当奖励对比稀缺时，其优势尤为显著：在模型规模下，37%至98%的轨迹组奖励一致，但SRD仍能从采样轨迹中提取学习信号。在2B设置中，98%的组均为失败，RLVR训练成功率仅为0.0%，而加入SRD后，在相同轨迹预算下达到60.6%。结果表明，事后智能体经验不仅可用于评估或改进行为，还可用于塑造交互前的预测表征。

summary: This paper presents the HINTT system submitted to the 2nd Challenge and Workshop on Multilingual Conversational Speech Language Model (MLC-SLM). We address multilingual speaker-attributed ASR, where systems must determine who spoke when and what was spoken. We investigate two modeling strategies for this problem: a cascaded pipeline that combines speaker diarization with speech-LLM-based ASR, and a unified speech LLM that directly generates speaker labels, timestamps, and transcriptions. Our final submission is based on the cascaded pipeline, consisting of a fine-tuned DiariZen diarization model, a fine-tuned Qwen3-ASR model, and LLM-based generative error correction. For comparison, we also fine-tune VibeVoice-ASR as a unified model using the same official training data. All task-specific fine-tuning and model selection are performed using only the official MLC-SLM data, without external data or pseudo-labels. Experimental results demonstrate that the cascaded system remains more reliable under the MLC-SLM Task 1 conditions, while unified speech LLMs offer a promising direction for future speaker-attributed ASR.
title: HINTT Submission to the 2nd MLC-SLM Challenge: Comparing Cascaded and Unified Approaches to Diarization and ASR
title_translated: HINTT系统提交第二届多语言对话语音语言模型挑战赛：级联与统一方法在说话人分离与ASR中的比较
summary_translated: 本文介绍了提交至第二届多语言对话语音语言模型（MLC-SLM）挑战赛与研讨会的HINTT系统。我们研究多语言说话人归属的自动语音识别（ASR），即系统需确定谁在何时说了什么。针对该问题，我们探索两种建模策略：一种是将说话人分离与基于语音大语言模型的ASR结合的级联流程，另一种是直接生成说话人标签、时间戳和转录内容的统一语音大语言模型。最终提交方案基于级联流程，包含微调后的DiariZen说话人分离模型、微调后的Qwen3-ASR模型以及基于大语言模型的生成式纠错模块。作为对比，我们也使用相同官方训练数据对VibeVoice-ASR进行统一模型微调。所有特定任务的微调与模型选择均仅使用官方MLC-SLM数据，不依赖外部数据或伪标签。实验结果表明，在MLC-SLM任务1条件下，级联系统仍更可靠，而统一语音大语言模型为未来说话人归属ASR提供了有前景的方向。

summary: LLM agents often lack the operational knowledge to act reliably in new environments, as they must discover specific tool behaviors or environment conventions on their own. Without memory of past attempts, they repeat the same mistakes across tasks, leading to more task failures and longer trajectories. To address this, agentic systems typically rely on human-written guidelines or on procedural memory built from training tasks and an oracle verifier, both of which require prior knowledge of the environment. We present DAEDALUS, a method for bootstrapping reusable agent memory from self-generated practice without existing tasks or oracle verifiers. DAEDALUS pairs two agents: an explorer that interacts with the environment to generate challenging yet solvable tasks, and a solver that attempts them. A heuristic is derived from each solver failure and accepted only after the solver repeatedly succeeds with that heuristic in context. These outcomes also provide feedback for the explorer to refine the difficulty of future tasks. Accepted heuristics are then consolidated into a memory bank for test-time use. Across AppWorld, $τ^2$-bench, and AutomationBench, DAEDALUS improves mean success rates by up to 15.9 points and pass^5 by up to 2.2x over a no-memory baseline, and is competitive with methods using training tasks, at a lower inference cost than most. We show that performance gains already emerge with a small exploration budget, and that its heuristics also benefit agents from other model families. Our ablations further reveal that solver traces provide the key information needed to derive effective heuristics, while factorizing early discoveries makes exploration more cost-efficient. Beyond memory construction, we find that the tasks generated by DAEDALUS can serve as a proxy for benchmark tasks when ranking models by performance. Code and artifacts: www.github.com/illuin-tech/daedalus.
title: DAEDALUS: Bootstrapping Agent Memory from Self-Generated Tasks
comment: 9 pages (31 including Appendix), 8 figures (11 including Appendix). We release the code and artifacts, including generation and inference traces, at this https URL
title_translated: DAEDALUS：从自生成任务中启动智能体记忆
summary_translated: 大型语言模型智能体在新环境中往往缺乏可靠操作知识，因为它们必须自行发现特定工具行为或环境惯例。由于缺乏过往尝试的记忆，它们在不同任务中重复犯错，导致更多任务失败和更长的轨迹。为解决此问题，现有智能体系统通常依赖人工编写的指南或基于训练任务和oracle验证器构建的过程记忆，两者均需预先了解环境。我们提出DAEDALUS，一种无需现有任务或oracle验证器即可从自生成练习中启动可复用智能体记忆的方法。DAEDALUS配对两个智能体：探索者与环境交互生成具有挑战性但可解的任务，求解者尝试这些任务。每当求解者失败时，会衍生出一个启发式规则，并在求解者多次成功应用该规则后才被接受。这些结果也为探索者提供反馈，以优化未来任务难度。被接受的启发式规则随后整合进记忆库供测试时使用。在AppWorld、τ²-bench和AutomationBench上，DAEDALUS相较于无记忆基线，平均成功率提升最高达15.9点，pass^5提升最高达2.2倍，且性能与使用训练任务的方法相当，但推理成本更低。我们还发现，即使探索预算较小，性能提升也已显现，且其启发式规则对其他模型家族的智能体也有益处。消融实验进一步表明，求解者的轨迹是推导有效启发式的关键信息，而早期发现的因子化使探索更具成本效益。除记忆构建外，我们还发现DAEDALUS生成的任务可作为模型性能排名的基准任务代理。

summary: Model merging aims to build a multi-task model cheaply by combining the weights of individual task-specific models. To perform well across multiple tasks, most existing merging methods use an additional dataset to find the coefficients for the best linear combination of task-specific weight updates. However, we identify an implicit regularization in this standard practice: searching over coefficients restricts the candidate models to a subspace spanned by task-specific weight updates. In this work, we investigate whether this regularization is actually useful. Surprisingly, empirical results show that optimizing merged-model weights without this regularization significantly boosts the performance of common merging methods across multiple architectures, domains, and even in an extremely data-limited scenario where only one instance is available per class. Moreover, directly optimizing the pretrained model weights even outperforms some existing merging methods. Analysis shows that better multi-task weights exist outside the subspace and can be found using multiple methods. We study different strategies for using the additional dataset, discussing their practical use and implications for model merging. Overall, this work calls for revisiting the existing model-merging pipeline, motivating a broader exploration of the weight space and a reconsideration of the implicit regularization induced by task arithmetic.
title: A Broader Look at Model Merging: Rethinking Implicit Regularization Induced by Task Arithmetic
title_translated: 对模型融合的更广泛审视：重新思考任务算术引发的隐式正则化
summary_translated: 模型融合旨在通过组合各任务专用模型的权重，低成本构建多任务模型。为在多个任务上表现良好，大多数现有融合方法使用额外数据集来寻找最佳线性组合的系数。然而，我们识别出这一标准实践中的隐式正则化：系数搜索将候选模型限制在由任务专用权重更新张成的子空间内。本文探究这种正则化是否真正有益。令人惊讶的是，实证结果表明，在不施加该正则化的情况下优化融合模型权重，显著提升了多种架构、领域甚至在极端数据受限场景（每类仅一个样本）下的常见融合方法性能。此外，直接优化预训练模型权重甚至优于某些现有融合方法。分析显示，更好的多任务权重存在于该子空间之外，可通过多种方法找到。我们研究了使用额外数据集的不同策略，讨论其实际应用及对模型融合的影响。总体而言，本工作呼吁重新审视现有的模型融合流程，推动对权重空间的更广泛探索，并重新考虑任务算术带来的隐式正则化。

summary: Multimodal large language models have become the dominant paradigm for visual understanding, but incur substantial costs by encoding inputs into dense, fixed-size patch tokens. However, visual information is unevenly distributed: some regions require fine-grained detail, while others admit compact representations. Downsampling sacrifices this detail, while existing token pruning and adaptive approaches remain limited in content-adaptive granularity, task generalization, and integration with modern MLLMs and serving infrastructure. Overcoming these limitations calls for foundation models that learn, end to end, where-and at what granularity-to allocate visual representations, a native capability we term elastic visual representation weaving. We introduce VisionWeave, establishing this capability in frontier-level MLLMs through large-scale training. It combines two components: a gated spatial pooler constructs coarse-grained representations alongside native fine-grained representations within a shared MRoPE coordinate, while a granularity router learns their content-adaptive allocation. Through self-distillation alone, we validate this capability on Qwen3.5-4B and scale to Qwen3.8-27B with over 30K A100 GPU-hours. Based on Qwen3.8-27B, VisionWeave adaptively adjusts token savings to visual content, saving 43.0% tokens on average while retaining 98.9% native performance across eight benchmarks, versus only 88% performance preserved for token pruning baselines with a fixed 50% savings target. Extensive evaluations confirm robust efficiency-quality trade-offs across diverse tasks, resolutions and video frames. When deployed on SGLang serving engine, our method achieves a 2.3x throughput gain while reducing mean TTFT by 54.4% and mean TPOT by 60.6%. Together, we believe these results position elastic visual weaving as a promising capability for next-generation multimodal models.
title: VisionWeave: Weaving Elastic Visual Representations as a Native Capability of MLLMs
title_translated: VisionWeave：将弹性视觉表征编织作为多模态大模型的原生能力
summary_translated: 多模态大语言模型已成为视觉理解的主导范式，但通过将输入编码为密集的固定大小块标记，带来巨大开销。然而，视觉信息分布不均：某些区域需要细粒度细节，而其他区域可采用紧凑表示。下采样会牺牲细节，而现有标记剪枝和自适应方法在内容自适应粒度、任务泛化性和与现代多模态大模型及服务基础设施的集成方面仍存在局限。克服这些局限需要基础模型能够端到端地学习在何处以及以何种粒度分配视觉表征，我们称之为弹性视觉表征编织的原生能力。我们提出VisionWeave，通过大规模训练在前沿水平的多模态大模型中建立这一能力。它包含两个组件：门控空间池化器在共享MRoPE坐标中同时构建粗粒度与原生细粒度表示，而粒度路由器学习其内容自适应分配。仅通过自蒸馏，我们在Qwen3.5-4B上验证了该能力，并扩展至Qwen3.8-27B，耗时超过3万小时A100 GPU。基于Qwen3.8-27B，VisionWeave根据视觉内容自适应调整标记节省，平均节省43.0%标记，同时在八个基准测试中保持98.9%的原生性能，而固定50%节省目标的标记剪枝基线仅保留88%性能。大量评估证实了在多样化任务、分辨率和视频帧上的稳健效率-质量权衡。在SGLang服务引擎部署中，我们的方法实现2.3倍吞吐提升，平均TTFT降低54.4%，平均TPOT降低60.6%。综上，我们认为弹性视觉编织是下一代多模态模型的有前景能力。

summary: When using an LLM agent in a consequential domain, making an informed decision about whether to trust its output or intervene requires calibrated confidence in the agent's success. Confidence estimation for agents is difficult because evidence about success is distributed across heterogeneous, interdependent steps of an agent's trajectory. Practical agentic deployments introduce further challenges: frontier LLMs often provide limited access to internal signals, agent roll-outs are costly, and training data may be unavailable or quickly become outdated. To address these challenges, we introduce Confidence Reasoning Graphs (CRGs), an inference-time framework that estimates the probability an agent accomplished its task from a single trajectory, without privileged model access or training data. Rather than compressing an execution into a single holistic judgment, a CRG begins with the claim that the agent accomplished its task, decomposes it into contextualized sub-claims grounded in trajectory evidence, estimates confidence for each terminal claim, and finally aggregates these into an overall confidence estimate. Across three agentic benchmarks, three backbone models, and three agent frameworks, CRGs yield better-calibrated confidence and stronger risk-aware decision making than verbalized, sampling-based, and white-box surrogate baselines. We further find that calibration error alone can be misleading: a white-box surrogate baseline appears well calibrated while providing near-chance discrimination. Ablations attribute CRG's improvements to claim-level confidence estimation and aggregation rather than graph construction alone. Finally, a CRG exposes the claims and trajectory evidence underlying each confidence estimate, enabling it to be audited at decision time.
title: Confidence Reasoning Graphs: Structured Confidence Estimation for LLM Agents
title_translated: 置信度推理图：大语言模型智能体的结构化置信度估计
summary_translated: 在关键领域使用大语言模型智能体时，判断是否信任其输出或需要干预，需要对智能体成功概率有校准的置信度。由于成功证据分布在智能体轨迹的异构且相互依赖的步骤中，对智能体进行置信度估计十分困难。实际智能体部署还引入了额外挑战：前沿大模型通常无法访问内部信号，智能体运行成本高，且训练数据可能不可用或迅速过时。为应对这些挑战，我们提出置信度推理图（CRGs），一种无需特权模型访问或训练数据的推理时框架，可从单条轨迹估计智能体完成任务的概率。与将执行过程压缩为单一整体判断不同，CRG从智能体已完成任务的主张出发，将其分解为基于轨迹证据的上下文化子主张，分别估计每个终端主张的置信度，最终聚合为总体置信度估计。在三个智能体基准测试、三种主干模型和三种智能体框架上，CRGs在置信度校准和风险感知决策方面均优于口头化、采样型及白盒代理基线。我们进一步发现，仅靠校准误差可能具有误导性：一个白盒代理基线看似校准良好，但判别能力接近随机。消融实验表明，CRG的改进主要源于主张级别的置信度估计与聚合，而非图结构本身。最后，CRG揭示了每项置信度估计背后的主张和轨迹证据，使决策时刻可审计。

summary: We study sequential content sufficiency by investigating whether a representation retains the ordered target information available in its input. An information-theoretic decomposition separates input ambiguity, representation loss, and readout mismatch. We construct recoverable views where perfect agreement and joint isotropic Gaussianity coexist with zero target information, and establish limits imposed by deterministic canonical anchors. Token log-loss provides a one-sided information-loss bound; a fixed-penalty ridge analysis shows why rank alone cannot determine prediction risk. These results motivate CANOPE, a nonautoregressive framework with ordered latent canvases, canonical-token supervision, and geometric regularization. On 40,000 validation sequences, latent-agreement (PL0) and token-grounded (PL2) have nearly identical pooled ranks but reach 13.5% and 98.8% positional Recall@1, respectively, under strong natural corruption when the correct target length is provided. On 3,930 LJSpeech validation utterances, frozen PL2 with a trained MatchaTTS readout yields 21.54% word error rate (WER) on corrupted text, versus 99.22% for frozen PL0, while end-to-end MatchaTTS reaches 10.93%. These results show that geometric regularity alone does not guarantee recoverable sequential content or effective downstream access in the text settings studied here.
title: Isotropic Yet Undecodable: The Sequential Content-Sufficiency Gap in Latent-Predictive Text Representations
title_translated: 各向同性却不可解码：潜在预测文本表示中的序列内容充分性差距
summary_translated: 我们通过研究表示是否保留输入中有序目标信息来探讨序列内容充分性问题。信息论分解将输入模糊性、表示损失和读出不匹配分离。我们构建了可恢复视图，其中完美一致性和联合各向同性高斯性共存于零目标信息场景，并确立了由确定性规范锚点施加的限制。词元对数损失提供了一侧的信息损失界；固定惩罚岭分析表明，仅凭秩无法决定预测风险。这些结果启发了CANOPE，一种非自回归框架，包含有序潜在画布、规范词元监督和几何正则化。在40,000个验证序列上，潜在一致性（PL0）和词元基础（PL2）的合并排名几乎相同，但在强自然噪声下，当正确目标长度已知时，PL0和PL2的位置召回率@1分别为13.5%和98.8%。在3,930个LJSpeech验证语音片段上，冻结的PL2配合训练好的MatchaTTS读出模块在受损文本上的词错误率为21.54%，而冻结的PL0为99.22%，端到端的MatchaTTS达到10.93%。这些结果表明，几何规则性本身并不能保证在所研究的文本设置中实现可恢复的序列内容或有效的下游访问。

summary: Ternary language models such as BitNet b1.58, Falcon-E and BitCPM are fine-tuned with higher-precision latent weights and deployed as ternary codes produced by an export step that, in the labs' documented pipelines, first casts the latents to bf16. We audit those pipelines across three labs. In released checkpoints, fp32 quantization of the shipped latents disagrees with the deployed codes on 0.83-1.77% of codes in Falcon-E and BitCPM and on 1.530% in BitNet 2B-4T; for Falcon-E and BitCPM most disagreements are products that bf16 rounding lands exactly on the threshold, which ties-to-even maps to zero, and the unmodified onebitllms exporter reproduces all four Falcon-E releases byte for byte. At fine-tuned endpoints, with learning rates selected to match a nominal learning-rate-to-bf16-ULP ratio, the documented export lowers greedy GSM8K strict accuracy from 58.79% to 0.78% for Falcon-E-1B-Base and from 36.13% to 0.39% for BitCPM-CANN-0.5B, and a bf16 save and reload lowers BitNet 2B-4T's strict accuracy by 27.54 points while its last-number accuracy rises. Two compatibility remedies, writing the training quantizer's codes directly or adjusting the bf16 inputs until the unchanged tools emit them, each met a 4-point strict-accuracy non-inferiority criterion against online evaluation in all three models. In two model families, randomized interventions on the initial distance from the threshold support distance-dependent selection of the codes that fine-tuning changes.
title: Lost in the bf16 Cast: Exporting Ternary Language Models Can Revert Most Low-Learning-Rate Code Changes
title_translated: bf16转换中的迷失：导出三值语言模型会逆转大多数低学习率代码变更
summary_translated: 如BitNet b1.58、Falcon-E和BitCPM等三值语言模型通过更高精度的潜在权重进行微调，并通过导出步骤部署为三值代码，该步骤在实验室记录的流程中首先将潜在权重转换为bf16。我们在三个实验室的流程中审计了这一过程。在发布的检查点中，fp32量化后的运输潜在权重与部署代码在Falcon-E和BitCPM中存在0.83%-1.77%的差异，在BitNet 2B-4T中为1.530%；Falcon-E和BitCPM中的多数差异源于bf16舍入恰好落在阈值上，导致四舍六入到偶数映射为零，而未经修改的onebitllms导出器能逐字节复现所有四个Falcon-E发布版本。在微调终点，当选择的学习率以匹配名义学习率与bf16-ULP比率时，文档化的导出将Falcon-E-1B-Base的贪婪GSM8K严格准确率从58.79%降至0.78%，将BitCPM-CANN-0.5B从36.13%降至0.39%；而bf16保存与重载使BitNet 2B-4T的严格准确率下降27.54分，其末位数字准确率上升。两种兼容性修复方案——直接写入训练量化器的代码或调整bf16输入直到不变工具输出它们——在所有三个模型中均满足4分严格准确率非劣性标准，与在线评估相比。在两个模型族中，对初始距离阈值的随机干预支持基于距离的选择，即微调改变的代码。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) equipped with terminal access have demonstrated strong capabilities in automating software engineering tasks. However, existing agents remain brittle on long-horizon workflows, where they must repeatedly reconstruct program state scattered across source files, configurations, tests, dependencies, and runtime behavior, leading to increasingly long interaction histories, context explosion, and semantic drift. Large repositories further complicate the identification of task-relevant components. To address these challenges, we introduce \textbf{Dev-Primitives} (\emph{Development Primitives}), a modular and executable abstraction that transforms repository components from passive software artifacts into active participants in software engineering. Each Dev-Primitive pairs a repository artifact with a resident LLM, which gives the artifact an agent-native interface grounded in its own implementation and dependencies, enabling natural-language reasoning, inter-component communication, and localized self-modification. Building on Dev-Primitives, we propose \textbf{HERMES}, a Harness Engineering framework for software engineeRing via Modular Executable Dev-PrimitiveS, which instantiates these primitives at repository scale through a dependency-aware dynamic activation mechanism and a bug diagnosis mechanism that maps execution evidence back to the components that must be revised. Extensive experiments on four software engineering benchmarks demonstrate that HERMES outperforms matched baseline harnesses by 12.4\% on average. Moreover, when paired with strong activation and diagnosis models, HERMES, even with Qwen3-8B Dev-Primitives, remains within 4.5\% of the homogeneous GPT-5.6 Sol configuration across all four benchmarks, while reducing inference cost by 26.2\% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, highlighting the importance of harness design in software engineering agents.
title: Harness Engineering for Software Engineering via Modular Executable Dev-Primitives
title_translated: 通过模块化可执行开发原语实现软件工程的Harness工程
summary_translated: 配备终端访问权限的大语言模型已在自动化软件工程任务中展现出强大能力。然而，现有智能体在长周期工作流中仍显脆弱，需反复重构分散在源文件、配置、测试、依赖关系和运行时行为中的程序状态，导致交互历史不断延长、上下文爆炸和语义漂移。大型代码库进一步增加了识别任务相关组件的难度。为解决这些挑战，我们引入了	extbf{Dev-Primitives}（开发原语），一种模块化且可执行的抽象，将代码库组件从被动软件资产转变为软件工程中的主动参与者。每个Dev-Primitive将代码库中的一个构件与其驻留的LLM配对，赋予该构件基于自身实现和依赖关系的智能体原生接口，从而支持自然语言推理、组件间通信和局部自我修改。在此基础上，我们提出了	extbf{HERMES}——一种通过模块化可执行Dev-Primitives实现软件工程Harness工程的框架，通过依赖感知的动态激活机制和将执行证据回溯至需修订组件的缺陷诊断机制，在代码库规模上实例化这些原语。在四个软件工程基准上的大量实验表明，HERMES平均比匹配基线提升12.4%。此外，当与强大的激活和诊断模型结合时，即使使用Qwen3-8B Dev-Primitives，HERMES在所有四个基准上也仅比同质的GPT-5.6 Sol配置落后4.5%，同时在Terminal-Bench 4.0上将推理成本降低26.2%，凸显了Harness设计在软件工程智能体中的重要性。

summary: Model merging offers a promising solution for combining multiple fine-tuned checkpoints into a single model through parameter arithmetic. However, finding optimal merging coefficients requires an extensive search that becomes prohibitively expensive as models scale in both size and number, due to high memory requirements and combinatorial growth in the search space. We show that, within the same model family, models exhibit highly congruent performance distributions over merging coefficients across different model sizes. This distributional similarity enables a practical paradigm we call \textit{$α$Transfer}: searching for optimal coefficients on a small proxy model, then directly transfer them to larger target models. We verify $α$Transfer across multiple merging methods, model families, and tasks. Experimental results demonstrate a 6$\times$ speedup and 70\% memory reduction on vision transformers, and a 20$\times$ speedup and 85\% memory reduction on large language models, while maintaining comparable performance. Our findings establish $α$Transfer as an efficient and generalizable approach to scaling model merging.
title: $α$Transfer: Coefficient Transfer for Efficient Model Merging
title_translated: $α$Transfer：高效模型融合中的系数迁移
summary_translated: 模型融合通过参数算术将多个微调检查点合并为单一模型，提供了一种有前景的解决方案。然而，寻找最优融合系数需要广泛搜索，随着模型规模和数量的增长，这一过程变得代价高昂，因内存需求高且搜索空间呈组合增长。我们发现，在同一模型家族内，不同模型尺寸下的融合系数性能分布高度一致。这种分布相似性催生了一种实用范式，称为	extit{$α$Transfer}：在小型代理模型上搜索最优系数，然后直接迁移到更大的目标模型。我们在多种融合方法、模型家族和任务上验证了$α$Transfer的有效性。实验结果表明，在视觉变换器上实现了6倍加速和70%内存减少，在大语言模型上实现20倍加速和85%内存减少，同时保持相当的性能。我们的发现确立了$α$Transfer作为一种高效且可扩展的模型融合方法。

summary: Small reasoning models (SRMs) have shown strong performance on complex reasoning tasks by generating extended chain-of-thought trajectories, but they often fail to recover once their reasoning enters an erroneous path. Existing test-time fusion methods rely on local fusion signals to determine when to trigger fusion, which can be misled by transient uncertainty fluctuations and may reinforce unstable reasoning trajectories. We propose ThinkFuse, a training-free test-time fusion framework that selectively intervenes in unreliable reasoning segments. ThinkFuse compares segment-level uncertainty shifts with trajectory-level uncertainty trends to identify unstable reasoning points and fuse auxiliary reasoning paths into the primary model's trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ThinkFuse outperforms baselines on mathematical and knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmarks, with consistent gains across model-family combinations, and remains robust with a smaller primary model. Our analysis shows that ThinkFuse requires fewer fusion triggers and generates fewer tokens, highlighting the efficiency of selective triggering. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/ThinkFuse.
title: ThinkFuse: Trajectory-Aware Test-Time Fusion for Small Reasoning Models
title_translated: ThinkFuse：面向小型推理模型的轨迹感知测试时融合方法
summary_translated: 小型推理模型（SRMs）通过生成扩展的思维链轨迹，在复杂推理任务中表现出色，但一旦推理进入错误路径便难以恢复。现有的测试时融合方法依赖局部融合信号来决定何时触发融合，容易受到瞬时不确定性波动的误导，并可能强化不稳定的推理轨迹。我们提出ThinkFuse，一种无需训练的测试时融合框架，可选择性地干预不可靠的推理片段。ThinkFuse通过比较段级不确定性变化与轨迹级不确定性趋势，识别出不稳定的推理点，并将辅助推理路径融合到主模型的轨迹中。大量实验表明，ThinkFuse在数学和知识密集型推理基准上优于基线方法，且在不同模型组合间均保持一致提升，即使使用更小的主模型也具有鲁棒性。分析显示，ThinkFuse所需的融合触发次数更少，生成的token也更少，凸显了选择性触发的高效性。代码已公开于https://github.com/js-lee-AI/ThinkFuse。

summary: Decomposing long-context inference across cooperating agents bounds the active KV cache per call rather than total evidence, which matters when KV-cache memory binds. Many such systems add a persistent tier storing and recalling reasoning traces, usually validated by an ablation reporting an accuracy gain. We measure both on one three-tier agent architecture. Decomposition delivers: peak KV working set of 14.3 MiB per query against 35.5 and 35.3 MiB for single-pass and retrieval-augmented baselines. The persistent tier does not: across eight controlled dataset pairs at n=100 per arm it costs +0.368 MiB [+0.167, +0.590] of peak cache and produces no detectable accuracy change (+0.015, 95% CI [-0.011, +0.046]). We argue the null is structural: single-question benchmarks supply each item with its own evidence and score it independently, and correctness requires resetting stored traces between conditions, so recall has nothing informative to retrieve. Reaching it took four measurement corrections -- three inflating the apparent benefit, the fourth making an effect that size look resolvable -- none visible in the results table. We give the conditions an agent-memory ablation must satisfy and detection procedures that need no knowledge of the specific defect.
title: Persistent Memory in Multi-Agent LLM Inference: What It Costs, What It Buys, and When You Can Tell
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure. Accepted as a poster at the Machine Learning for Systems Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
title_translated: 多智能体大语言模型推理中的持久记忆：代价、收益与可检测性
summary_translated: 在协作智能体之间分解长上下文推理，可以限制每次调用的活跃KV缓存，而非总证据量，这在KV缓存内存受限时尤为重要。许多此类系统引入持久层级以存储和召回推理轨迹，通常通过消融实验报告准确率提升来验证。我们在一个三层智能体架构上同时测量了这两方面。分解带来了每查询峰值KV工作集14.3 MiB，而单次通过和检索增强基线分别为35.5和35.3 MiB。然而，持久层级并未带来显著收益：在八个受控数据集对（每组n=100）中，其峰值缓存成本增加0.368 MiB（[0.167, 0.590]），准确率变化无显著差异（+0.015，95%置信区间[-0.011, +0.046]）。我们认为这一零效应是结构性的：单问题基准为每个项目提供独立证据并独立评分，正确性要求在不同条件下重置存储的轨迹，因此召回无法获取任何有信息量的内容。达到这一结论经历了四次测量修正——其中三次夸大了表面收益，第四次使该效应大小变得可分辨——但这些细节在结果表中均未体现。我们提出了智能体记忆消融必须满足的条件以及无需了解具体缺陷的检测程序。

summary: Post-training quantization reduces the cost of deploying language-model agents, but its effect on recovery from temporary tool failures can depend on how recovery is evaluated. We compare 8-bit and 4-bit variants of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on twenty deterministic tool-use tasks and five prompts. The 8-bit-4-bit recovery comparison changes direction across prompts and evaluation targets. On tasks that both variants complete without faults under the same prompt, the difference ranges from 0 to +20.2 percentage points for Llama and from -50.0 to +35.0 points for Qwen. Full-pipeline point estimates favor 8-bit Llama under all five prompts, whereas the Qwen comparison changes direction across prompts. The evaluation target can also reverse the result. For Llama under one prompt, scoring each variant only on its own clean-passing tasks favors 4-bit by 17.5 points; scoring the same tasks for both variants gives no difference, while scoring the full pipeline favors 8-bit by 28.3 points. Executor leniency is a third such choice. Rescoring the same logs with strict output parsing, which 8-bit Llama violates far more often than 4-bit Llama under that prompt, turns that +28.3 into -15.0 while leaving Qwen essentially unchanged. These findings show that one prompt, one screened task set, and one scoring policy do not establish a stable conclusion about quantized-agent robustness. Evaluations should compare variants on matched tasks, report full-pipeline success for deployment decisions, state the scoring policy, and quantify uncertainty across tasks rather than injected fault sites.
title: Quantization Effects on Tool-Failure Recovery Vary Across Prompts and Evaluation Designs
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Small Language Models for Agentic Systems (SLM-Agents). 7 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables, plus appendix
title_translated: 量化对工具故障恢复的影响因提示和评估设计而异
summary_translated: 后训练量化降低了部署语言模型智能体的成本，但其对临时工具故障恢复能力的影响可能取决于恢复评估方式。我们对比了Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct的8位与4位变体在二十个确定性工具使用任务和五个提示上的表现。8位与4位的恢复性能比较方向随提示和评估目标变化。在两个变体在同一提示下均能无故障完成的任务中，Llama的差异范围为0至+20.2个百分点，Qwen则为-50.0至+35.0个百分点。全管道点估计在所有五个提示下均支持8位Llama，而Qwen的比较结果在不同提示间方向反转。评估目标也可能逆转结果：对于Llama在某一提示下，仅对各自干净通过的任务评分时，4位版本领先17.5分；对同一任务双版本评分则无差异；而对全管道评分则8位版本领先28.3分。执行器宽容度是第三个影响因素。使用严格输出解析重新评分相同日志时（8位Llama在此提示下违反频率远高于4位Llama），原本的+28.3变为-15.0，而Qwen基本不变。这些发现表明，单一提示、一组筛选任务和一种评分策略无法建立关于量化智能体鲁棒性的稳定结论。评估应比较变体在匹配任务上的表现，报告部署决策所需的全管道成功率，明确说明评分策略，并量化跨任务的不确定性，而非仅关注注入故障点。

summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for post-training large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial computation and memory overhead during rollout generation, which motivates low-precision rollout for efficient RL training. However, existing FP4 RL methods suffer from a key limitation: they primarily optimize quantization accuracy on the training and rollout paths independently rather than directly reducing the discrepancy between the two quantized execution paths. In this work, we propose TRACE (Train-Rollout Quantization Alignment via Compact GuidancE), an FP4 quantization framework for RL training of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models that addresses the limitation of existing FP4 RL methods. TRACE incorporates rollout-guided quantization-aware training that uses rollout-side quantization outcomes to guide training-side FP4 rounding decisions, directly reducing train-rollout discrepancy. Moreover, TRACE adopts an efficient quantization-information caching scheme that selectively retains mantissa and scale information from deeper layers to reduce the storage and communication overhead introduced by rollout guidance. We evaluate TRACE on four large-scale MoE language models across reasoning, coding, and long-horizon RL tasks. Our results demonstrate that TRACE enables joint FP4 weight/activation and FP4 KV-cache rollout with RL performance comparable to BF16 rollout, while achieving up to 5.4xrollout speedup and strong final FP4 performance compared with post-hoc FP4 quantization of BF16-trained policies.
title: TRACE: Rollout-Guided Quantization-Aware Training for FP4 Reinforcement Learning of MoE Language Models
title_translated: TRACE：面向MoE语言模型FP4强化学习的滚动引导量化感知训练
summary_translated: 后训练大语言模型（LLM）的强化学习（RL）在滚动生成阶段产生巨大的计算和内存开销，这促使采用低精度滚动以实现高效的RL训练。然而，现有FP4 RL方法存在关键局限：它们主要独立优化训练路径和滚动路径的量化精度，而非直接减少两条量化执行路径之间的差异。本文提出TRACE（Train-Rollout Quantization Alignment via Compact GuidancE），一种用于Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）语言模型RL训练的FP4量化框架，解决了现有FP4 RL方法的不足。TRACE引入滚动引导的量化感知训练，利用滚动端的量化结果指导训练端的FP4舍入决策，直接减小训练-滚动差异。此外，TRACE采用高效的量化信息缓存机制，选择性保留深层的尾数和尺度信息，降低滚动引导带来的存储与通信开销。我们在四个大规模MoE语言模型上评估TRACE，涵盖推理、编码和长周期RL任务。结果表明，TRACE实现了联合FP4权重/激活与FP4 KV缓存滚动，其RL性能接近BF16滚动，同时实现高达5.4倍的滚动加速，并在最终FP4性能上显著优于后处理式BF16模型的FP4量化方案。

summary: Dense retrieval models are typically trained with contrastive objectives that learn effective representations but do not directly optimize retrieval metrics or downstream task performance. To address this problem, we introduce RELER (REinforcement LEarning for Retrieval), a reinforcement learning framework that enables existing embedding models to learn to retrieve directly in embedding space and align to task-specific rewards. We train RELER by sampling unit-length query and document embedding actions from von Mises-Fisher (vMF) distributions centered on normalized encoder outputs, scoring the resulting retrieval or downstream outcomes as rewards, and updating the encoder with REINFORCE using a leave-one-out baseline (RLOO). As exploration in the high-dimensional embedding space is prone to sampling noise, we further propose conditional-mean projection (CMP), which projects each sampled embedding onto the low-dimensional subspace spanned by its encoder output and the candidate embeddings it is compared against, reducing noise in the policy gradient while preserving its expectation. We evaluate RELER on BRIGHT, a benchmark with reasoning-intensive queries that remain challenging for existing embedding models. RELER consistently outperforms InfoNCE and LambdaLoss in average nDCG@10 when post-training BGE-M3 and Qwen3-Embedding backbones. We further evaluate downstream utility through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), where we adapt only the query encoder while keeping the document index and generator fixed. Across seven QA datasets, jointly optimizing retrieval and answer rewards improves both average retrieval performance and answer quality in RAG.
title: Learning to Retrieve via Reinforcement Learning in Embedding Space
title_translated: 通过嵌入空间中的强化学习学习检索
summary_translated: 密集检索模型通常使用对比目标进行训练，学习有效表示，但并不直接优化检索指标或下游任务性能。为解决此问题，我们提出RELER（REinforcement LEarning for Retrieval），一种强化学习框架，使现有嵌入模型能够直接在嵌入空间中学习检索，并与特定任务奖励对齐。我们通过从以归一化编码器输出为中心的冯·米塞斯-费舍尔（vMF）分布中采样单位长度的查询和文档嵌入动作，将所得检索或下游结果作为奖励，使用带留一法基线（RLOO）的REINFORCE更新编码器。由于高维嵌入空间中的探索易受采样噪声影响，我们进一步提出条件均值投影（CMP），将每个采样嵌入投影到由其编码器输出和所比较候选嵌入构成的低维子空间上，从而在保持策略梯度期望不变的前提下降低噪声。我们在BRIGHT基准上评估RELER，该基准包含对现有嵌入模型仍具挑战性的推理密集型查询。在对BGE-M3和Qwen3-Embedding骨干网络进行后训练时，RELER在平均nDCG@10上始终优于InfoNCE和LambdaLoss。我们还通过检索增强生成（RAG）评估下游效用，仅调整查询编码器而固定文档索引和生成器。在七个问答数据集上，联合优化检索与答案奖励显著提升了RAG中的平均检索性能和答案质量。

summary: A memory system can retire an obsolete value and later restore it merely because the same old statement appears again. A re-read of an old source and a genuine revert can produce the same observed sequence of values while requiring opposite current answers. We study this ambiguity on 130 extractor-selected atomic transitions derived from software fixes. In the ordinary transition condition, identity-based temporal memory reaches 98.5% model-judged accuracy with zero observed errors under a literal stale-value proxy. Appending a verbatim re-read of the old statement reduces accuracy to 10.8% and raises the stale-value rate to 88.5%. A guard that refuses to reactivate a previously retired value restores accuracy to 97.7% and reduces that rate to 0.8% in this constructed re-read condition. The guard cannot also recognize a legitimate revert without additional change provenance. Two supporting studies examine exposing retired history to the answer model and supplying current source for changed behavior. An exploratory extraction study over 707 software fixes provides scope context, not a universal coverage estimate. The design implication is to distinguish an observation of a value from evidence that the value changed. Selected inputs, aggregate-only answer records, related-family judges and a post-failure guard evaluation limit the conclusions to the retained experiments.
title: When Old Facts Return: Re-Reads, Reverts, and the Limits of Temporal Memory
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure. Ancillary files contain retained aggregate evidence, derived scenario and annotation exports, reference code, and an offline verifier
title_translated: 旧事实重现之时：重读、回滚与时间记忆的局限
summary_translated: 一个记忆系统在淘汰过时值后，仅因同一旧陈述再次出现而将其恢复。对旧源的重读与真实的回滚可能产生相同的观测值序列，但要求当前答案相反。我们在130个由软件修复提取的原子转换中研究了这一模糊性。在常规转换条件下，基于身份的时间记忆达到98.5%的模型判断准确率，且在字面过期值代理下无观测错误。添加旧陈述的逐字重读使准确率降至10.8%，过期值率升至88.5%。一种拒绝重新激活先前已淘汰值的保护机制在该构造的重读条件下将准确率恢复至97.7%，并将过期值率降至0.8%。该保护机制若无额外变更溯源信息，则无法识别合法回滚。两项支持性研究考察了向回答模型暴露已淘汰历史以及提供当前来源以应对行为变化。对707个软件修复的探索性提取研究提供了上下文范围，而非普遍覆盖估计。设计启示在于区分对值的观察与该值已改变的证据。选定输入、仅聚合的回答记录、相关家族评判者及失败后保护评估限制了结论仅适用于保留实验。

summary: Argument Mining (AM) is fundamentally constrained by the scarcity of high-quality structure-annotated datasets. While LLMs have shown promise in synthetic data generation, producing synthetic AM data that is both structurally accurate and sufficiently diverse remains a challenging problem. To address this problem, we revisit synthetic data generation for AM from a new perspective and propose a novel adversarial reinforcement learning framework for data synthesis. The proposed framework jointly optimizes the generator and the discriminator in an adversarial loop, in which the generator produces structured AM instances, and the discriminator provides learning signals by distinguishing real data from synthetic candidates. This enables the generator to progressively improve both the structural accuracy of generated argument data while maintaining diversity through adversarial feedback. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently improves AM performance on three benchmark datasets in both full-data and low-resource settings, validating its effectiveness and scalability.
title: Improving Synthetic Data Generation for Argument Mining via Adversarial Reinforcement Learning
title_translated: 通过对抗强化学习改进论点挖掘的合成数据生成
summary_translated: 论点挖掘（AM）本质上受限于高质量结构标注数据集的稀缺性。尽管大语言模型在合成数据生成方面展现出潜力，但生成既结构准确又足够多样化的合成AM数据仍是难题。为解决此问题，我们从新视角重新审视AM的合成数据生成，并提出一种新颖的对抗强化学习框架用于数据合成。该框架在对抗循环中联合优化生成器与判别器：生成器生成结构化的AM实例，判别器通过区分真实数据与合成候选来提供学习信号。这使得生成器能够通过对抗反馈逐步提升生成论点数据的结构准确性，同时保持多样性。大量实验表明，所提框架在三个基准数据集上均能持续提升AM性能，无论是在全数据还是低资源设置下，验证了其有效性和可扩展性。

summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) engage tools, share memory, and delegate tasks, often encountering adversarial content. Current defenses for MAS are typically evaluated in isolation, focusing on one attack type at a time, which can lead to costly and hard-to-audit outcomes. This study organizes defenses into five principles, implementing them as DEFER1 (DEterministic-First Enforcement with Residual judgment), which includes a cascade of 28 checks that blocks what it can and refers the rest to a panel of four judges. In independent testing across four domains, attack success rates drop from about 30.0% to approximately 3.0%, with 78% of blocked attacks handled by deterministic checks. Only a quarter of proposals reach the judges in the security-operations domain, illustrating that the rules provide security for attacks violating clear policies, while judges manage those that only misrepresent intent. Both systems have weaknesses, such as a risk-score approval gate that inaccurately approves most attack proposals but few legitimate ones, highlighting the challenges in assessing threats accurately.
title: Where Rules End and Judges Begin: Measuring the Judgment Boundary in Multi-Agent Systems Security
title_translated: 规则止步之处，裁判开始：多智能体系统安全中的判断边界测量
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统（MAS）使用工具、共享内存并委派任务，常遭遇恶意内容。当前MAS防御通常孤立评估，每次只关注一种攻击类型，可能导致代价高昂且难以审计的结果。本研究将防御归纳为五项原则，并实现为DEFER1（确定性优先执行与残余判断），包含28个检查级联，优先阻断可识别攻击，其余交由四位裁判组成的小组处理。在四个领域的独立测试中，攻击成功率从约30.0%降至约3.0%，其中78%的被阻攻击由确定性检查处理。在安全运营领域，仅有四分之一的提案进入裁判环节，说明规则可防范明显违反政策的攻击，而裁判则负责处理仅意图误导的案例。两套系统均有缺陷，例如风险评分审批门限虽误批多数攻击提案，却极少误批合法请求，凸显准确评估威胁的挑战。

summary: Speech becomes less intelligible in noisy environments, and humans naturally adapt their voice to compensate. Inspired by this behavior, we investigate whether a text-to-speech (TTS) model can be guided to produce more intelligible speech using activation steering, without retraining. We focus on two characteristics of the Lombard effect: increased vocal effort and hyper-articulation. We introduce a prompt-relative steering mechanism that prevents steering effects from accumulating during generation while allowing their strength to be adjusted dynamically. Across seen and unseen speakers and multiple languages, our method produces systematic changes in Lombard-related acoustic features, preserves speaker similarity (89-95%), and reduces WER under background noise by 7-22% at 1 dB SNR. These results show that pretrained TTS models can be dynamically controlled to generate more intelligible speech without retraining.
title: Loud and Clear: Dynamic Activation Steering for Improving Speech Intelligibility in Noisy Environments
title_translated: 响亮清晰：动态激活引导以提升嘈杂环境下的语音可懂度
summary_translated: 在嘈杂环境中，语音可懂度下降，人类会自然调整发声方式以补偿。受此行为启发，我们探究是否可通过激活引导，在不重新训练的前提下，引导文本到语音（TTS）模型生成更具可懂性的语音。我们聚焦于Lombard效应的两个特征：增强的发声努力和超清晰发音。我们引入一种相对于提示的引导机制，防止引导效应在生成过程中累积，同时允许其强度动态调整。在已见与未见说话人及多种语言下，该方法系统性地改变了与Lombard相关的声学特征，保持了说话人相似性（89–95%），并在1 dB信噪比下将词错误率（WER）降低7–22%。结果表明，预训练TTS模型可被动态控制以生成更可懂的语音，无需重新训练。

summary: Prosodic stress is a crucial aspect of automatic pronunciation assessment (APA), encompassing both sentence stress detection (SSD) and word stress detection (WSD). SSD highlights semantically salient words that shape discourse meaning, while WSD identifies the primary stressed syllable within each word to ensure lexical clarity.
